subject: Runway fidelity score & SLA optioning
messages:
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cogentretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T09:12:00Z
Subject: Q2 usage fidelity & runway check — Redwood

Jonas / Marissa,

Thanks for the runway report you shared last quarter. We're seeing a sharper-than-expected rise in token spend around our recommendations pipeline (embeddings + generation mix) and want to make sure we don't hit throttles come Black Friday prep. I pulled our exports for Q2 (attached) — highlights:

- Token burn up ~42% QoQ, but embeddings requests doubled for personalization flows.
- 95th percentile inference latency crept from 210ms -> 350ms for long-context sessions.
- A few user segments show retry loops in logs that inflate token count.

Can we get a short readout this week on:
1) What the fidelity impact looks like if we shift more calls to a cheaper embedding model vs our current standard.
2) Trade-offs to guarantee p95 <= 300ms for the checkout/profile flows.
3) Any quick mitigations (burst credits, canary capacity changes) you recommend while we decide on a commit change.

Attaching: cogent_q2_token_export.csv (summary + per-route breakdown).

Prefer a 30-min sync Thu/Fri. Amelia

Attachments: cogent_q2_token_export.csv (CSV - 1.2MB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cogentretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage fidelity & runway check — Redwood

Amelia — thanks for this and the export. Quick read-through; high level notes here and a proposed agenda if that helps structure the call. Attached a short digest and the token breakdown we pulled so Marissa/Ben and I all line up.

Snapshot takeaways (from our side):
- The token mix shift to embeddings is the dominant driver of QoQ spend (+38% spend attributable). Embeddings are high-volume but low-latency sensitive for you.
- The latency delta at p95 looks correlated with session length (context window growth) and opportunistic batching — for long contexts we see cache misses that increase compute.
- There are a few prompt-level retry patterns we can mitigate immediately (client-side debounce + small rate-limiter).

Quick options to consider (short-term -> medium):
1) Burst credits + short Dedicated slab for personalization routes (30-day trial) — gives guaranteed throughput and lower unit price for embeddings.
2) Model substitution for non-critical embeddings (slightly lower-dim embedding model) — 8-12% cost savings with <2% fidelity loss on retrieval tests.
3) Prefix/KV caching at the SDK layer for long-context sessions — reduces p95 when cache hit ratio >55%.

Proposed 30-min agenda:
- 0–5m: Goals & critical flows (you)
- 5–15m: Token mix & latency drivers (our data)
- 15–25m: Concrete mitigations + pricing sketch (options 1–3)
- 25–30m: Next steps / mutual action plan + owners

I attached: jw_q2_digest.pdf and token_burn_breakdown.xlsx for the figures I referenced.

Available Thu 10:00–11:30 or Fri 14:00–17:00 PT — pick a slot and we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Jonas

Attachments: jw_q2_digest.pdf (PDF - 240KB); token_burn_breakdown.xlsx (XLSX - 620KB)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-07-19T14:22:00Z
Subject: Internal: Cogent prep — proposed pricing levers & ask

Marissa / Ben — quick internal note ahead of the external call. Keeping it short:

Ask: Approve a short 30-day Dedicated trial for their personalization embedding routes plus a 10% introductory uplift discount on committed price for the trial period. Rationale below.

Why Dedicated trial?
- Guarantees p95 headroom while we assess fidelity trade-offs.
- We'll get representative KV cache hit data and real-latency numbers under real traffic.

Pricing levers to offer (if we need to compress):
- Option A (trial): 30-day Dedicated slab, month-to-month, 10% off committed rate, auto-convert to a 6-month reserved at standard tier unless declined.
- Option B (managed burst): Flexible burst credits (pre-purchased pool) + overage at slightly higher unit price. Lower commitment.

Operational notes:
- Marissa: can you produce a one-slide delta: expected unit-cost reduction (embeddings) if they move 60% of personalization to the lower-dim model? Need by EOD tomorrow.
- Ben: if we propose Dedicated slab, will need ops ETA for provisioning + SLO addendum (p95 target 300ms). Can you ballpark?

If both thumbs-up, I'll share Option A at the call and emphasize a short mutual action plan so procurement has a path to sign.

Thanks — J
From: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cogentretail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@cogentretail.com
Date: 2027-07-20T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage fidelity & runway check — Redwood

Jonas — appreciate the quick turnaround. Thu 10:00 PT works for us (I'll put the invite on the calendar).

A few clarifying points before the call:
- Procurement looped in (procurement@cogentretail.com) — they prefer clear trial terms and an auto-convert opt-out clause.
- We're most sensitive to p95 on checkout/profile routes — if you can show a clear mitigation path to <=300ms that's the main gating criteria.
- On fidelity: we can pilot the lower-dim embeddings on a small user cohort (10%) first and measure recall/CTR delta.

Attached: our procurement contact card (please coordinate the SOW). Also, we'll bring our engineering lead to the call for latency specifics.

Thanks — Amelia

Attachments: procurement_contact_v2.vcf (vCard)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Torres <amelia.torres@cogentretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, procurement@cogentretail.com
Date: 2027-07-21T15:04:00Z
Subject: Re: Q2 usage fidelity & runway check — Redwood — agenda + next steps

Amelia / team — thanks, confirmed Thu 2027-07-22 10:00 PT (calendar sent). Quick pre-read + meeting materials attached.

Meeting deliverables we'll aim for:
- Short, shared runbook for the 30-day Dedicated trial (owners + provisioning ETA).
- Pilot plan for 10% lower-dim embedding rollout (A/B metrics to track: recall@20, CTR, avg tokens/request).
- Concrete SLO language for p95 target <=300ms and fallback policy if not met.
- Procurement items: trial terms (auto-convert opt-out) + PO path.

Immediate next steps (who):
- Jonas (me): share the trial SOW draft + provisioning ETA by EOD tomorrow. (attached: agenda_renewal_readout.md)
- Marissa: one-slide cost delta for 60% model shift (EOD tomorrow).
- Ben: ops provisioning ETA + SLO addendum draft (EOD tomorrow).

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—Jonas

Attachments: agenda_renewal_readout.md (MD - 3KB)
